raw_text: The Election Commission has taken cognisance of a fabricated audio clip targeting a Chief Minister ahead of state polls. The commission has directed cybercrime units to trace the origin of the deepfake audio, which experts have confirmed was generated using AI voice synthesis. Political parties have traded accusations over responsibility for the manipulation, raising concerns about the use of synthetic media in Indian elections.
clean_text: Election Commission took cognisance of fabricated CM audio deepfake. Cybercrime units directed to trace origin. Experts confirmed AI voice synthesis.
